title: Shaped-rotor gravitational communication
description: Simulation code and numerical data for rotating-mass Newtonian gravitational communication: source fields, constrained modulation, causal decoding, packet BER qualification, steel and tungsten rotor mechanics, tone-count studies, arrays, and finite-size magnetic links through conducting barriers. Includes the complete numerical data archive in datasets/. See docs/RELEASE_v0.5.0.md for scope, reproducibility and modeling limitations.
